module.title: Automation and Multi-Agent Orchestration
module.business_purpose: A governed layer that lets multiple AI agents (and deterministic bots) automate the capture, enrichment, validation and routing of information records across the platform — the "dynamic multi-agent automation layer" the clients asked for. Registers agents with versioned definitions, the tools they may call, and the guardrails/policies that bound them; orchestrates work through triggers -> workflows -> tasks -> agent runs -> steps, with per-record automations, human-in-the-loop approvals, agent memory/knowledge and a full append-only execution trail. Every automated write is attributable and auditable.
